name: dns-worker
description: Privacy-first DNS & DoH Resolver with modern Web Dashboard, built for Cloudflare Workers & Node.js

scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:dev && concurrently "npm run ui:dev" "wrangler dev"
scripts.build:serverfull: npm run db:generate-migrations && npm run ui:build && node scripts/precompress.mjs static && npx esbuild src/serverfull/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/serverfull.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --external:node:sqlite --minify --sourcemap --tree-shaking=true --legal-comments=none && npx esbuild src/serverfull/walWorker.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/walWorker.mjs --external:node:sqlite --minify --legal-comments=none
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:prod && wrangler deploy
scripts.build:pages: npm run db:generate-migrations && npm run ui:build && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=static/_worker.js --platform=neutral --format=esm --minify --external:cloudflare:* --external:node:*
scripts.prepare: npm run db:generate-migrations && npm run ui:install
scripts.db:status: wrangler d1 execute dns_worker_db --local --command='SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table"'
scripts.test: tsx test/test_fingerprint_set.ts && tsx test/test_filter_yield.ts && tsx test/test_filter_load_invalidate.ts && tsx test/test_byte_capped_map.ts && tsx test/test_legacy_compat.ts && tsx test/test_bloom_precision.ts && tsx test/test_bloom_params_migration.ts && tsx test/test_limit_warning_survives_304.ts && tsx test/test_list_limit_warnings.ts && tsx test/test_sync_optimizations.ts && tsx test/test_sync_pacing.ts && tsx test/test_adguard_hybrid_pipeline.ts && tsx test/test_cache_purge.ts && tsx test/test_dns_decoder_boundary.ts && tsx test/test_settings_validation.ts && tsx test/test_ecs.ts && tsx test/test_dns_cache_ttl_and_sweep.ts && tsx test/test_log_retention_unmetered_chunked.ts && tsx test/test_user_fixes_verification.ts && tsx test/test_cache_hit_rollup.ts && tsx test/test_block_redirect_log_dedupe.ts && tsx test/test_block_mark_release.ts && tsx test/test_log_queue_cap.ts && tsx test/test_e2ee_retry_keeps_payload.ts && tsx test/test_e2ee_fail_closed.ts && tsx test/test_analytics_range_accuracy.ts && tsx test/test_analytics_edges_exact.ts && tsx test/test_hit_retention_and_alignment.ts && tsx test/test_log_range_validation.ts && tsx test/test_custom_range_input.ts && tsx test/test_fail_filter_index.ts && tsx test/test_icon_candidates.ts && tsx test/test_refresh_cooldown.ts && tsx test/test_wal_checkpoint_worker.ts && tsx test/test_backup_pipeline.ts
